# VPN Scout - NordVPN Programmatic SEO Site

Next.js 14 programmatic SEO site for NordVPN affiliate.

**Affiliate Link:** https://nordvpn.sjv.io/Dym2Wa

**Pages:** 170+ auto generated
- Best VPN for use cases (30)
- VPN for countries (50)
- VPN for devices (15)
- NordVPN vs competitors (10)
- Streaming guides (20)
- Features (15)
- How-to guides (20)
- Static: review, pricing, deal, about, privacy, disclosure, contact

**Tech:** Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, SSG

**SEO:** sitemap.xml, robots.txt, JSON-LD, metadata, affiliate disclosure in footer

**Deploy:** Vercel - just connect repo, build command `npm run build`

## Run

```
npm install
npm run dev
```
